mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai.byai_group_chat_forward_request (request_id, enterprise_id, actor_user_id, source_session_id, client_request_id, mode, request_hash, frozen_json, source_manifest_json, snapshot_version, backend) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{actorUserId}, #{sourceSessionId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{mode}, #{requestHash}, #{frozenJson}, #{sourceManifestJson}, #{snapshotVersion}, #{backend})
INSERT INTO byai.byai_group_chat_forward_target (target_id, enterprise_id, request_id, target_session_id) VALUES (#{targetId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{requestId}, #{targetSessionId})

INSERT INTO byai.byai_group_chat_forward_item (item_id, enterprise_id, request_id, target_id, ordinal, selected_message_id, selected_merged_card, source_message_id, content, speaker_json, source_created_at, references_json, attachments_json) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{requestId}, #{targetId}, #{ordinal}, #{selectedMessageId}, #{selectedMergedCard}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{content}, #{speakerJson}, #{sourceCreatedAt}, #{referencesJson}, #{attachmentsJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE byai.byai_group_chat_forward_request SET lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=clock_timestamp() + (CAST(#{leaseMillis} AS BIGINT) * INTERVAL '0.001' SECOND), fencing_version=fencing_version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND state='RUNNING' AND sources_frozen=FALSE AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= clock_timestamp()) AND #{leaseMillis} > 0

UPDATE byai.byai_group_chat_forward_target SET lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=clock_timestamp() + (CAST(#{leaseMillis} AS BIGINT) * INTERVAL '0.001' SECOND), fencing_version=fencing_version+1, state=CASE WHEN state='READY' THEN 'READY' ELSE 'COPYING' END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND state IN ('PENDING','COPYING','READY') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= clock_timestamp()) AND #{leaseMillis} > 0

UPDATE byai.byai_group_chat_forward_target SET state='PENDING', error_code=NULL, retryable=FALSE, fencing_version=fencing_version+1, lease_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND state='FAILED' AND retryable=TRUE AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= clock_timestamp())

UPDATE byai.byai_group_chat_forward_request SET lease_until=GREATEST(lease_until, clock_timestamp() + (CAST(#{leaseMillis} AS BIGINT) * INTERVAL '0.001' SECOND)), update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE enterprise_id=#{lease.actor.enterpriseId} AND request_id=#{lease.requestId} AND actor_user_id=#{lease.actor.userId} AND lease_owner=#{lease.owner} AND fencing_version=#{lease.fencingVersion} AND state='RUNNING' AND sources_frozen=FALSE AND lease_until > clock_timestamp() AND #{leaseMillis} > 0
